summary_en: 50,000 shares (1.65% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on June 26, 2026 at ¥1,205/share, total cost ceiling ¥60.25M. Execution window: single session (8:45 a.m. JST), results to be disclosed same day. Method: off-exchange buy (ToSTNeT-3).
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Exchange Buy Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On June 25, 2026, AuBEX Corporation's board resolved to acquire up to 50,000 treasury shares (1.65% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) on June 26, 2026 at a fixed price of ¥1,205 per share via ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange transaction, with a total cost ceiling of ¥60.25M. The purchase order will be placed at 8:45 a.m. JST during the single execution window of that day's ToSTNeT-3 session and is valid only for that session. The acquisition is intended to support stable supply of shares for the company's equity grant trust (J-ESOP) plan and to enable flexible capital-allocation execution in response to changing business conditions. Results will be disclosed upon closure of the 8:45 a.m. trading session the same day. Execution is contingent on matching sell orders in the market; partial or full non-execution is possible.
